author: Inside Edition
description: Police wrestled with a man that had jewelry in his mouth, wanting him to spit it out. A man entered a Tiffany store in Orlando, Florida posing as a rep for an NBA player. He was escorted into the VIP room and shown a try of million-dollar jewels. Then the man, identified as Jaythan Gilder, snatched two sets of earrings and a ring and ran out. When police caught up with Gilder, he swallowed the jewelry. He was forced to stay in a hospital and the evidence expelled from his system.
title: Florida Man Steals Luxury Jewelry Then Swallows It

author: Inside Edition
description: A conflict is raging the current president and a former one, all over The Cheesecake Factory. At a recent campaign rally, Barack Obama took a shot at Donald Trump's White House remodeling, observing that “He’s got the White House looking like Saddam Hussein opened a Cheesecake Factory.” President Trump hit back at his predecessor, calling Obama a "lousy president." Inside Edition's Steven Fabian has more.
title: Donald Trump And Barack Obama Spar Over Cheesecake Factory

author: Inside Edition
description:
A Florida woman who is being called a 'real life "Home Alone" mom was arrested while returning from a Las Vegas work trip, authorities said. Irene Miller, 50, allegedly left her four children, ages 9, 11,12 and 14, at home, overnight, without adult supervision. Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano spoke exclusively with the mom's estranged husband, Mark Miller, who is now looking after the kids.

A GoFundMe has been set up to help Miller and the kids. For more information, click this link: https://ietv.co/4klDJfL
title: Estranged Husband Of Alleged Real-Life 'Home Alone' Mom Speaks Out

author: Inside Edition
description: The final week of October is a popular time for families to gather together and carve a pumpkin. But the time-honored Halloween tradition of making a jack-o-lantern is not without risk. Some unfortunate souls are finding out the hard way that Halloween decorating mishaps may land you in the emergency room. Inside Edition's Justin Finch spoke with a doctor to find out how to stay safe during the spooky season.
title: How To Carve A Pumpkin Without Hurting Yourself

author: Inside Edition
description: A bond was formed 25 years ago when a child wrote a letter to a New York City fire fighter in the tough days after 9/11. Now retired, Captain Tom Brown says he has held onto the letter since. What happened to that little girl named Emily? She's now Dr. Emily Clark, a fifth-grade teacher at a school on Long Island, in the same town Brown is from. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Retired FNDY Captain Meets Girl Who Wrote Him A Letter After 9/11

author: Inside Edition
description: Authorities are searching for a convicted killer who walked out of a Tennessee prison late Sunday night. Jacob Morley was wearing his prison uniform when he "breached the perimeter fence and exited the facility," said a statement from the Department of Correction. Morley was serving a life sentence for first-degree murder after police discovered the body of a missing person under his home in 2022.
title: Convicted Murderer On The Loose After Escaping Tennessee Prison

author: Inside Edition
description: A little girl in Greensboro, North Carolina, got the surprise of a lifetime when she was gifted a genie lamp. Her mother, who has been overseas with the U.S. Air Force, made her dream come true when she surprised her at school. Quiana Quiros tells Inside Edition Digital, “I was just so excited to just hold her one more time.” She added, “words just can't describe how blessed, I feel, to just have made it back.”
title: Military Mom Surprises Daughter at School After Spending Months Overseas

author: Inside Edition
description: It happened so fast, these officers could only watch. A deer came crashing through the window of an apartment it entered earlier and then just ran away. Police say they were called to handle the intruder after it broke into the home by also smashing through a window.
title: Deer Breaks Windows Entering And Exiting Apartment Building #shorts
